goal: Play a full round: put out fires, rescue everyone, refill water
summary: The playtester only ran 8 steps and never started a round. Every ProximityPrompt interaction (Axe rack, Extinguisher rack, Mission Board) returned 'held, not triggered', so no gear was granted and no call was picked. No fires were fought, no one was rescued and no water was refilled. The server probe reported no errors, only background traffic activity.

bugs.title: Gear rack prompts never trigger, so no tool is granted
bugs.evidence: Steps 1 and 3: interacting with GearRack1 'Grab Axe' at about 7.8 and 3.6 studs returned 'held, not triggered'. Step 4: GearRack2 'Grab Extinguisher' gave the same result. The Carrying attribute stayed empty and the HUD still showed 'empty hands'. This may also be an interact-tool or hold-duration problem; the same result on the Mission Board suggests it is not specific to the racks.

bugs.title: Mission Board 'Pick a call' prompt does not trigger, so the round cannot start
bugs.evidence: Step 8: standing about 8 studs from MissionBoard (within the stated range of 16), interact returned 'held, not triggered' for 'Pick a call Mission Board'. No round or squad state changed afterwards.

bugs.title: No walkable path from the locker room to the Mission Board
bugs.evidence: Step 5: walk_to MissionBoard stopped 31.7 studs short ('straight (no path: NoPath)'). Step 7: the move to (-46,3.3,170) also reported NoPath and fell back to a straight-line walk, though it did arrive. The route from the locker room to the lobby may be blocked or missing from the navmesh.
